name: aci_api_call
description: Call the Cisco ACI (APIC) REST API. Rooted at https://<host>; every path carries its own prefix. Auth (login cookie) is handled for you; do NOT call /api/aaaLogin. Returns {status_code, data, error, blast_radius}. Two query styles: CLASS queries (GET /api/node/class/<moClass>.json — every object of a type) and MO queries (GET /api/node/mo/<dn>.json — one object by distinguished name). Results are under data['imdata'] (list of {className:{attributes:{...}}}) with data['totalCount']. Key classes: fvTenant, fvAEPg (EPGs), fvBD (bridge domains), fvCtx (VRFs), vzBrCP (contracts), l3extOut (L3Outs), topSystem/fabricNode (inventory), fabricHealthTotal (health), faultInst (faults). Refine with query_params: query-target=subtree, rsp-subtree=children|full, query-target-filter=eq(fvTenant.name,"X"), page/page-size. Writes (POST an MO tree to its DN / DELETE a DN) hit the live fabric. Check status_code < 400 before trusting data.

function.name: aci_api_call
function.description: Call the Cisco ACI (APIC) REST API rooted at https://<host>. Auth is handled internally.
